post.description: Start here to find trademark records and their st13 identifiers; pass an st13 to get_trademark for the full record.

brand_name_strategy.description:
How the brand name is matched: Simple = embedded (the site's default), Fuzzy, Phonetic, Stemming, Terms = exact phrase.

Provider reference: allowed values ["Simple", "Fuzzy", "Phonetic", "Stemming", "Terms"]; default "Simple".

cursor.description: Offset of the next page as returned in `next_cursor`; omit for the first page. Pattern: ^[0-9]{1,7}$.

include_facets.description: Also return aggregate counts (owner, applicant country, office, designation, Nice class, status, mark feature, kind, type) for the whole result set. Adds ~400 KB upstream; request it once, not on every page.

nice_classes.description: Nice classes the record must all carry (brick `niceClass`, all_of).

number.description: Application or registration number as the office writes it (brick `number`, either field).

offices.description: IP office codes, any of (brick `office`): ISO country codes plus EM (EUIPO), WO (Madrid). get_coverage lists every office.

rows.description:
Hits per page (the site uses 30; 60 is its maximum).

Provider reference: minimum 1; maximum 60; default 30.

sort.description:
Sort order; `score desc` is relevance.

Provider reference: allowed values ["score desc", "applicationDate desc", "applicationDate asc"]; default "score desc".

200.description:
Search trademark records in the WIPO Global Brand Database (POST /search). Combine a brand name (embedded, fuzzy, phonetic, stemming or exact-phrase match), an owner name, an application or registration number, goods and services text, Nice classes, IP offices, designated territories and statuses; all given criteria are ANDed. Pages of up to 60 hits with offset pagination; `include_facets` adds the aggregate counts the site's Explore view shows (owner, country, class, status...).

The response contains the tool result directly.

The provider identifies `results` as the primary payload key.

| Documented field | Provider type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `applicant_country_codes` | string[] |  |
| `applicants` | string[] |  |
| `application_date` | string | YYYY-MM-DD. |
| `application_number` | string |  |
| `brand_names` | string[] | Verbal elements of the mark as indexed (may repeat per language). |
| `collection` | string | Source collection id (office code + tm), used in image paths. |
| `designations` | string[] |  |
| `expiry_date` | string |  |
| `kind` | string[] |  |
| `logo_ids` | string[] |  |
| `mark_feature` | string | Word, Figurative, Combined, ... |
| `nice_classes` | number[] |  |
| `office` | string | IP office code (EM = EUIPO, WO = Madrid). |
| `record_url` | string | The record in the site's UI. |
| `registration_date` | string |  |
| `registration_number` | string |  |
| `score` | number |  |
| `st13` | string | WIPO ST.13 record identifier; input of get_trademark. |
| `status` | string |  |
| `termination_date` | string |  |
| `thumbnail_urls` | string[] | images.branddb.wipo.int thumbnail per logo id. The image host requires the same HashSearch request header as the API (any GUID); a bare GET answers 403. |
| `type` | string | TRADEMARK, EMBLEM, INN, AO, ... |


These are the provider's documented fields. Field requiredness, nullability and nested object structures are specified only where the descriptions explicitly say so.
